name: UGC Generator
description: A Claude / agent skill that turns a product brief into authentic UGC — selfie clips, talking-head ads, and on-camera demos — through Unsora over MCP.

steps.title: Connect Unsora
steps.body: Add the Unsora MCP to Claude, Cursor, or your agent. OAuth through the marketplace plugin, or an API key for local setups.

steps.title: Install the skill
steps.body: Drop ugc-generator into your skills folder, or pull it from the tryunsora GitHub repo. Your assistant loads the workflow automatically.

steps.title: Brief it in chat
steps.body: Describe the product, hook, and who should be on camera. The skill structures the prompt — shot, action, lighting, dialogue — then calls create_video.

steps.title: Ship the clip
steps.body: Get a full-res UGC spot back in the thread. Iterate on the hook, swap the face, or schedule it to TikTok and Instagram without leaving chat.

examples: Make a 9:16 UGC ad for our vitamin C serum — kitchen selfie, casual, 8 seconds.
Talking-head clip: creator unboxes the wireless earbuds and hits one benefit.
Product demo with our bottle in frame — natural light, authentic not polished.
requirements: Unsora account with credits
MCP connected (Claude plugin or API key)
Optional: product stills as public HTTPS URLs
ctaHeadline: Ready to generate UGC from chat?
ctaBody: Download UGC Generator, connect Unsora, and ask for the spot.

name: Create Video
description: Generate Seedance 2.0 videos through Unsora — text-to-video, image-to-video with reference frames, product demos, and cinematic clips from chat.

steps.title: Connect Unsora
steps.body: Add the Unsora MCP to Claude, Cursor, or your agent. OAuth through the marketplace plugin, or an API key for local setups.

steps.title: Install the skill
steps.body: Add create-video from the tryunsora repo. Your assistant learns the Seedance workflow and when to use omni reference vs first/last frames.

steps.title: Describe the shot
steps.body: Subject, setting, duration, and ratio. Attach reference image URLs when you want image-to-video. The skill checks credits, then calls create_video.

steps.title: Iterate in thread
steps.body: Preview lands in chat. Ask for a different ratio, longer cut, or hand off to schedule-post when you are ready to publish.

examples: Create a 9:16 Seedance video of a product demo in a kitchen, 8 seconds.
Animate this product still into a slow hero reveal, 16:9.
Cinematic b-roll of earbuds on black glass with soft rim light.
requirements: Unsora account with credits
MCP connected (Claude plugin or API key)
Optional: public HTTPS image URLs for references
ctaHeadline: Ready to generate video from chat?
ctaBody: Download Create Video, connect Unsora, and describe the shot.

name: Clip Video
description: Turn a YouTube or direct video URL into short clips with AI clipping — captions, aspect ratios, and Find Moments mode for specific highlights.

steps.title: Connect Unsora
steps.body: Add the Unsora MCP to Claude, Cursor, or your agent. OAuth through the marketplace plugin, or an API key for local setups.

steps.title: Install the skill
steps.body: Add clip-video so your assistant knows to confirm source, ratio, captions, count, and length before spending credits.

steps.title: Point at the source
steps.body: Paste a YouTube or .mp4 URL. Optionally describe moments to find. The skill runs create_clipping with your choices locked in.

steps.title: Pick winners
steps.body: Review the short clips in chat, then schedule the best ones to Instagram or TikTok with schedule-post.

examples: Clip this YouTube video into 5 vertical Shorts with yellow captions.
Find funny reaction moments and cut them to under 30 seconds.
Repurpose this podcast episode into 9:16 Reels, captions on.
requirements: Unsora account with credits
MCP connected (Claude plugin or API key)
YouTube URL or direct .mp4 URL
ctaHeadline: Ready to clip long-form into shorts?
ctaBody: Download Clip Video, connect Unsora, and paste a source URL.

name: Create Thumbnail
description: Generate YouTube-style 16:9 thumbnails with face references, template styles, expressions, and multiple variations for A/B testing.

steps.title: Connect Unsora
steps.body: Add the Unsora MCP to Claude, Cursor, or your agent. OAuth through the marketplace plugin, or an API key for local setups.

steps.title: Install the skill
steps.body: Add create-thumbnail so your assistant gathers topic, face refs, and variation count before calling the tool.

steps.title: Brief the cover
steps.body: Share the video hook, optional face URL, and how many options you want. The skill checks credits and runs create_thumbnail.

steps.title: Pick a winner
steps.body: Compare variations in chat, refine expression or layout, and keep the strongest CTR option.

examples: Make 4 YouTube thumbnails for a video about AI UGC ads — shocked expression.
Thumbnail with my face reference, bold text energy, 16:9.
Generate CTR covers mimicking this template layout.
requirements: Unsora account with credits
MCP connected (Claude plugin or API key)
Optional: face or template image URLs
ctaHeadline: Ready to generate thumbnails from chat?
ctaBody: Download Create Thumbnail, connect Unsora, and brief the cover.

name: Schedule Post
description: Schedule or draft Instagram and TikTok posts using generated media — checks subscription, lists connected accounts, and posts with captions.

steps.title: Connect Unsora
steps.body: Add the Unsora MCP to Claude, Cursor, or your agent. OAuth through the marketplace plugin, or an API key for local setups.

steps.title: Install the skill
steps.body: Add schedule-post so your assistant verifies plan and connected accounts before creating a post.

steps.title: Pick media & caption
steps.body: Point at a generated video or image URL, write the caption, choose accounts and time. The skill calls create_post.

steps.title: Confirm the queue
steps.body: Get confirmation back in chat. Adjust caption, reschedule, or draft for later without leaving the thread.

examples: Schedule this clip to TikTok tomorrow at 6pm with this caption.
Draft an Instagram Reel post from the last video we generated.
Post this thumbnail carousel to Instagram — caption ready.
requirements: Active Unsora paid plan
Instagram or TikTok connected in the app
Public HTTPS media URL from a prior generation
ctaBody: Download Schedule Post, connect accounts, and queue the drop.

name: Vox Collage Video
description: Turn a script or fact list into a finished Vox-style paper-collage explainer — torn-edge photo cut-outs, kinetic typography, one bold accent color — generated end-to-end on Unsora and cut to the narration with ffmpeg.

steps.title: Connect Unsora
steps.body: Add the Unsora MCP to Claude, Cursor, or your agent. OAuth through the marketplace plugin, or an API key for local setups.

steps.title: Install the skill
steps.body: Drop vox-style-collage-video into your skills folder — SKILL.md plus the style-dna, pipeline, and beat-mapping references that define the whole visual system.

steps.title: Paste the script, approve the cut
steps.body: Share a script, beat list, or bare idea. The skill maps beats to shots, drafts the VO, and presents a full shot list — nothing generates until you say go.

steps.title: Generate and assemble
steps.body: Voiceover is timed first, then every shot runs through create_image and create_video with an optional mureka underscore — ffmpeg cuts each clip to its line and mixes the final MP4.

examples: Make a Vox-style explainer from this script — 16:9, yellow accent.
Turn these five facts about the housing market into a 60-second paper-collage video.
Write and voice narration for a Vox-style short on EV batteries, 9:16.
requirements: Unsora account with credits
MCP connected (Claude plugin or API key)
ffmpeg + ffprobe installed locally
Voiceover: a supplied audio file or a TTS tool in the session
ctaBody: Download Vox Collage Video, connect Unsora, and paste your script.

name: Media Router
tagline: One skill for any media ask
description: Smart default entry — introspects the live Unsora MCP catalog, picks the best tool for generate, clip, or schedule requests, and defers to specialized skills when they fit.

steps.title: Connect Unsora
steps.body: Add the Unsora MCP to Claude, Cursor, or your agent. OAuth through the marketplace plugin, or an API key for local setups.

steps.title: Install the skill
steps.body: Add media-router as your default Unsora skill. It discovers tools each session instead of hardcoding names.

steps.title: Ask in plain language
steps.body: Generate, clip, thumbnail, music, influencer, or schedule — the router matches intent to the right MCP tool.

steps.title: Hand off when needed
steps.body: When a specialized skill fits better (UGC, clipping, thumbnails), the router defers so the deeper workflow takes over.

examples: Check my Unsora credits.
Make me a short product video and a matching thumbnail.
Clip this YouTube link and schedule the best one to TikTok.
requirements: Unsora account with credits
MCP connected (Claude plugin or API key)
ctaHeadline: Ready for one skill that routes it all?
ctaBody: Download Media Router, connect Unsora, and ask for anything media.
